segments.text: Episode thirteen. Next stop... a magnetar.
A magnetar is a neutron star with the most powerful magnetic field known in the universe.
segments.headline: The strongest magnets known

segments.text: Its magnetic field is about a thousand trillion times stronger than Earth's.
Put one halfway to the Moon, and it would erase every credit card on Earth.
segments.headline: Wipes credit cards from far away

segments.text: Get within about a thousand kilometers, and its field would tear apart the atoms in your body.
segments.headline: Deadly from 1,000 km

segments.text: In two thousand four, a magnetar fifty thousand light-years away flared so brightly it disturbed Earth's upper atmosphere.

visual.label: light-years away, and felt on Earth
